verses.original: מִזְמ֗וֹר לְדָ֫וִ֥ד יְהוָ֣ה קְ֭רָאתִיךָ ח֣וּשָׁה לִּ֑י הַאֲזִ֥ינָה ק֝וֹלִ֗י בְּקָרְאִי־ לָֽךְ׃
verses.transliteration: miz·mō·wr lə·ḏā·wiḏ Yah·weh qə·rā·ṯî·ḵā ḥū·šāh lî ha·’ă·zî·nāh qō·w·lî bə·qā·rə·’î- lāḵ
verses.literal: A Psalm of David I call upon You O LORD come quickly to me Hear my voice when I call to You

verses.original: תִּכּ֤וֹן תְּפִלָּתִ֣י קְטֹ֣רֶת לְפָנֶ֑יךָ מַֽשְׂאַ֥ת כַּ֝פַּ֗י מִנְחַת־ עָֽרֶב׃
verses.transliteration: tik·kō·wn tə·p̄il·lā·ṯî qə·ṭō·reṯ lə·p̄ā·ne·ḵā maś·’aṯ kap·pay min·ḥaṯ- ‘ā·reḇ
verses.literal: May my prayer be set before You like incense my uplifted hands like the evening offering

verses.original: שִׁיתָ֣ה יְ֭הוָה שָׁמְרָ֣ה לְפִ֑י נִ֝צְּרָ֗ה עַל־ דַּ֥ל שְׂפָתָֽי׃
verses.transliteration: šî·ṯāh Yah·weh šā·mə·rāh lə·p̄î niṣ·ṣə·rāh ‘al- dal śə·p̄ā·ṯāy
verses.literal: Set a guard O LORD over my mouth keep watch at the door of my lips

verses.original: אַל־ תַּט־ לִבִּ֨י לְדָבָ֪ר׀ רָ֡ע לְהִתְע֘וֹלֵ֤ל עֲלִל֨וֹת׀ בְּרֶ֗שַׁע אֶת־ אִישִׁ֥ים פֹּֽעֲלֵי־ אָ֑וֶן וּבַל־ אֶ֝לְחַ֗ם בְּמַנְעַמֵּיהֶֽם׃
verses.transliteration: ’al- taṭ- lib·bî lə·ḏā·ḇār rā‘ lə·hiṯ·‘ō·w·lêl ‘ă·li·lō·wṯ bə·re·ša‘ ’eṯ- ’î·šîm pō·‘ă·lê- ’ā·wen ū·ḇal- ’el·ḥam bə·man·‘am·mê·hem
verses.literal: Do not let my heart be drawn to any evil thing or take part in works of wickedness with men who do iniquity let me not feast on their delicacies

verses.original: יֶֽהֶלְמֵֽנִי־ צַדִּ֨יק׀ חֶ֡סֶד וְֽיוֹכִיחֵ֗נִי שֶׁ֣מֶן רֹ֭אשׁ אַל־ יָנִ֣י רֹאשִׁ֑י כִּי־ ע֥וֹד וּ֝תְפִלָּתִ֗י בְּרָעוֹתֵיהֶֽם׃
verses.transliteration: ye·hel·mê·nî- ṣad·dîq ḥe·seḏ wə·yō·w·ḵî·ḥê·nî še·men rōš ’al- yā·nî rō·šî kî- ‘ō·wḏ ū·ṯə·p̄il·lā·ṯî bə·rā·‘ō·w·ṯê·hem
verses.literal: Let the righteous man strike me let his rebuke be an act of loving devotion It is oil for my head let me not refuse it . . . For my prayer is ever against . . . the deeds of the wicked

verses.original: נִשְׁמְט֣וּ בִֽידֵי־ סֶ֭לַע שֹׁפְטֵיהֶ֑ם וְשָׁמְע֥וּ אֲ֝מָרַ֗י כִּ֣י נָעֵֽמוּ׃
verses.transliteration: niš·mə·ṭū ḇî·ḏê- se·la‘ šō·p̄ə·ṭê·hem wə·šā·mə·‘ū ’ă·mā·ray kî nā·‘ê·mū
verses.literal: When their rulers are thrown down from the cliffs the people will listen to my words for they are pleasant

verses.original: כְּמ֤וֹ פֹלֵ֣חַ וּבֹקֵ֣עַ בָּאָ֑רֶץ נִפְזְר֥וּ עֲ֝צָמֵ֗ינוּ לְפִ֣י שְׁאֽוֹל׃
verses.transliteration: kə·mōw p̄ō·lê·aḥ ū·ḇō·qê·a‘ bā·’ā·reṣ nip̄·zə·rū ‘ă·ṣā·mê·nū lə·p̄î šə·’ō·wl
verses.literal: As when one plows and breaks up the soil so our bones have been scattered at the mouth of Sheol

verses.original: כִּ֤י אֵלֶ֨יךָ׀ יְהֹוִ֣ה אֲדֹנָ֣י עֵינָ֑י בְּכָ֥ה חָ֝סִ֗יתִי אַל־ תְּעַ֥ר נַפְשִֽׁי׃
verses.transliteration: kî ’ê·le·ḵā Yah·weh ’ă·ḏō·nāy ‘ê·nāy bə·ḵāh ḥā·sî·ṯî ’al- tə·‘ar nap̄·šî
verses.literal: But my eyes are fixed on You O GOD the Lord In You I seek refuge do not leave my soul defenseless

verses.original: שָׁמְרֵ֗נִי מִ֣ידֵי פַ֭ח יָ֣קְשׁוּ לִ֑י וּ֝מֹקְשׁ֗וֹת פֹּ֣עֲלֵי אָֽוֶן׃
verses.transliteration: šā·mə·rê·nî mî·ḏê p̄aḥ yā·qə·šū lî ū·mō·qə·šō·wṯ pō·‘ă·lê ’ā·wen
verses.literal: Keep me from the snares they have laid for me and from the lures of evildoers . . .

verses.original: יִפְּל֣וּ בְמַכְמֹרָ֣יו רְשָׁעִ֑ים יַ֥חַד אָ֝נֹכִ֗י עַֽד־ אֶעֱבֽוֹר׃
verses.literal: Let the wicked . . . fall into their own nets while I pass by in safety
